notes: MEASURED from /proc/mtd on the reference device — this is the actual onboard SPI-NAND, ~120 MiB total (nominal 128 MB device). CRITICAL CAVEAT: the reference build's RDK-B rootfs does NOT boot from this onboard flash — it boots from a separate 256 GB development SD card (mmcblk0, root partition ~14 GiB, 7.2 GiB used). This onboard flash layout therefore does NOT demonstrate that the 512 MB minFlashMB floor (Section 3, CRF-001) is sufficient, or insufficient, for a production rootfs — the production storage medium was never exercised by this measurement. This partition table is real and precise for what it covers (bootloader/factory/FIP/UBI), but a production flash sizing exercise against an actual deployable Yocto image is still needed; see Hardware Compatibility Specification Section 5.1.1 and Section 3.7's existing flash-floor reconciliation flag.
